tagline: Chinon数码单反相机，1978 年发布
description: Chinon于1978年推出的数码单反相机。配备Chinon Auto, 55mm f/1.4 (Standard lens), Multi-coated, M42 mount, w/ Manual and Auto lens settings feature, filter thread 55 mm, Aperture: f/1.4-f/16。快门速度Seiko MFC-ES, stepless electromagnetic focal plane metal shutter, verticaly travelling。

specs.电池: 3v, two silver oxide 1.5v, eg.G13/S76, (accepts lithium Kodak K58L or two alkaline, eg. LR44)
specs.镜头: Chinon Auto, 55mm f/1.4 (Standard lens), Multi-coated, M42 mount, w/ Manual and Auto lens settings feature, filter thread 55 mm, Aperture: f/1.4-f/16
specs.快门: Seiko MFC-ES, stepless electromagnetic focal plane metal shutter, verticaly travelling
specs.取景器: SLR pentaprism, Speeds Scale and Exposure Indicator Needle are visible in it
specs.曝光测光: TTL CdS meter, two cells, centre weighted, aperture priority automatic exposure control

The Chinon CE-3 Memotron is a 35mm electronic SLR camera made by Chinon and introduced c.1978 as the last in the Chinon CE Memotron series.
